subject: general
question: Find the simple interest on ₹700 at 9% per month in 7 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹700

Rate of interest (R) = 9% per month

Time (T) = 7 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (700 × 9 × 7) / 100

⇒ SI = (700 × 63) / 100

⇒ SI = 44100 / 100

⇒ SI = 441

**The simple interest on ₹700 at 9% per month in 7 months is ₹441.**
